title: Kir and compartment interaction investigation with measured-data checks

titles: Apical and basal dendritic spine plasticity during learning, including Kir perturbation

scientific_question: How do prespecified relative-rank coactivity–plasticity associations differ across Kir/control and apical/basal groups after checking baseline overlap and mouse-level sensitivity?
primary_outputs: Prespecified Kir-by-neural-feature-by-compartment contrasts and cohort sensitivity estimates from measured records, plus valid null/unavailable/rank-deficient/zero-overlap dispositions. No nonzero Kir effect is assumed correct.

data_manifest.file_count_scope: Top-level published assets, including code/docs where packaged together; not a participant count.

recording_contract.neural: Per-mouse/FOV/session dictionaries include spine event rates, movement/nonmovement measures, local/coincident coactivity and event-aligned spine/dendrite traces. Selected Kir dictionaries additionally include time × cell dFoF; the primary scoped task uses measured spine-level features.
recording_contract.labels: spine_volumes/followup_volumes, spine_flags/followup_flags, dendrite_ids, branch_order, positions and session define longitudinal plasticity labels; author structural_plasticity recomputes volume-change classes rather than only plotting aggregate values.
recording_contract.time_alignment: Early/Middle/Late session and followup pairs provide the feature-task temporal contract; parameters include SamplingRate/ActivityWindow for available traces. Exact seconds between every longitudinal visit and raw continuous traces are not verified, so no general forecasting-timescale claim.
recording_contract.biological_ids: mouse_id,FOV,session and dendrite_ids are documented fields. Main_Pipeline explicitly lists control apical/basal and Kir cohorts; some mouse IDs occur in both compartments. Group by mouse first, then FOV/dendrite/spine, preserving repeated measures.
recording_contract.evidence: 430 archive directory entries; ReadME, Main_Pipeline, utilities and structural_plasticity inspected by bounded ZIP ranges. Per-measurement dictionaries are inputs; no pickle deserialization or numerical analysis occurred.

primary.name: complete interaction-report numerical error
primary.aggregation: Report each prespecified relative-rank WLS interaction, group support and balanced-panel contrast against an independent recomputation, with native-unit tolerances frozen only after recovering original arithmetic.
primary.rationale: A structural JSON acceptance check cannot establish correct biological analysis; the revised primary measures the numerical estimands and support actually claimed.

secondary: Mouse-deletion stability and complete all-versus-balanced-support comparison.
Baseline-size/activity overlap, group acquisition sensitivity and rank/estimability diagnostics.
Prespecified three-way interaction with its lower-order terms, avoiding selective two-group comparisons.

comparators.name: Nuisance-only cohort model
comparators.inputs: Baseline morphology, movement activity, compartment and cohort acquisition variables.
comparators.procedure: Freeze a mouse-balanced procedure and examine overlap before estimating Kir-dependent neural effects.

comparators.name: Common coactivity association
comparators.inputs: Same nuisance inputs plus a common neural slope.
comparators.procedure: Compare against the interaction model on identical support; report both coefficient sets.

comparators.name: Kir/compartment interaction
comparators.inputs: Same inputs plus prespecified neural×Kir×compartment terms.
comparators.procedure: Reproduce the declared rank/WLS estimand only after exact weights/rank conventions are recovered; missing overlap yields unavailable, not a fabricated zero.

nuisance_controls: Do not assume treatment allocation was randomized or exchangeable between source cohorts.
Balance baseline size and activity only using prespecified rules; show retained and excluded support.
Preserve paired apical/basal observations of the same mouse and handle cohort/acquisition differences.
evaluation.uncertainty: At most30 input mice with uncertainty tied to the actual estimable mouse roster; use complete-mouse deletion/cluster methods, not1936 row-level replicates. If rank deficiency or zero overlap prevents an estimand, report that without forced pooling.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require all report terms and support/dispositions; structural validity never substitutes for trusted numerical comparison. Preserve null, unavailable, rank-deficient and zero-overlap results. Do not silently discard failed contrasts.
